name: week
title: This week
subtitle: Lease Accounting for Claude Code: what needs attention, rendered by npm run view

sections.title: Rule breaches
sections.note: Each rule and its source is in docs/compliance.md.
sections.sql: select rule, record as lease, entity, finding from compliance_findings order by severity, rule, record

sections.title: Critical dates: missed and the next 120 days
sections.note: Option deadlines lose the option if missed. A CPI or market review in effect with no new rent leaves the liability understated.
sections.sql: select reference as lease, entity, description, event, due_on, due_on - current_date as days, detail, owner from critical_dates where due_on <= current_date + 120 and (due_on >= current_date or event in ('option: last day to exercise','rent review','bank guarantee expires')) order by due_on

name: register
title: Lease register
subtitle: Every active lease with its rent, liability and right-of-use asset today

sections.title: By entity
sections.sql: select entity, currency, count(*)::int as leases, count(*) filter (where exemption <> 'none')::int as exempt, round(sum(liability), 2) as liability, round(sum(rou), 2) as right_of_use from lease_register where status = 'active' group by entity, currency order by entity

sections.title: Every lease
sections.sql: select reference as lease, entity, asset_class, description, lessor, commencement_on, expiry_on, term_end_on, exemption, rent, per, liability, rou as right_of_use from lease_register where status = 'active' order by entity, reference

name: options
title: Options and reviews
subtitle: Every undecided option and every pending rent review

sections.title: Options
sections.sql: select l.reference as lease, e.code as entity, l.description, o.kind, o.term_months, o.exercise_by, o.exercise_by - current_date as days_left, o.reasonably_certain as in_lease_term, o.decision from options o join leases l on l.id = o.lease_id join entities e on e.id = l.entity_id where l.status = 'active' order by o.exercise_by

sections.title: Rent reviews waiting for the new rent
sections.sql: select reference as lease, entity, description, kind, effective_on, days, current_rent from review_book where new_amount is null order by effective_on
